aid.title: UF — Information for International Students (Student Financial Aid and Scholarships)

test_policy.notes: All first-year students must submit an SAT, ACT or CLT score (Florida Board of Governors regulation 6.002). UF has no test preference; scores may be self-reported at application, official scores due May 1. UF superscores SAT/ACT (ACT Science excluded).

requirements.supplemental_essays: Common App personal essay plus the UF Supplement (a few short-answer questions); Honors Program and Innovation Academy applicants write an additional essay.
requirements.notes: Common App is the only way to apply. International-school applicants submit transcripts (at least three years) and a course-by-course credential evaluation instead of the STARS self-report. The admissions pages do not mention recommendation letters or an interview.

deadlines.label: Early Decision (binding)
deadlines.notes: Materials deadline Oct 22. Confirm enrollment by Jan 8 or the decision is cancelled. Outcomes: admit, deny or defer.

deadlines.label: Early Action (non-binding)
deadlines.notes: Materials deadline Nov 8. Confirmation deadline May 1.

deadlines.label: Regular Decision (non-binding)
deadlines.notes: Materials deadline Jan 22. Confirmation deadline May 1 with a $200 non-refundable tuition deposit. Outcomes include waitlist or Pathways (PaCE).

aid.notes: Students on F-1/F-2/J-1/J-2 or G-series visas are not eligible for federal aid administered by UF; the page says they may be eligible for private or college-awarded scholarships. No international need-aid program is described.
